quests.title: Island Hopping
quests.summary: Work out the one day plan that fits a distillery tour, a Staffa boat and Iona's abbey.

steps.text: Take the Oban ferry to Tobermory and ask the distillery guide when the tour starts.
Ask the skipper at the boat office when the Staffa boat sails.
Sail to Iona and ask the pilgrim when the abbey closes.
Take the plan back to Morag at the CalMac terminal in Oban.

quests.reward: Isle of Mull Cheddar, an Iona Pebble charm, a CalMac Timetable and Scottish standing.

quests.title: Rob Roy's Outlaw Trail
quests.summary: Follow the MacGregor outlaw's trail round Loch Lomond and face the Duke's Factor.

steps.text: Visit Rob Roy's Cave on the east shore.
Hear the story at Balquhidder Kirk.
Beat Montrose's Factor, lurking by the loch east of the cave.
Report to Red Mac near Balloch.

quests.reward: The Outlaw's Sporran charm and Scottish standing.

quests.title: The Heavy Events
quests.summary: Win the caber, the hammer and the stones at the Oban Highland Games.

steps.text: Collect your medal from the Games Marshal.

quests.reward: The Heavy Events Medal charm, tablet and Scottish standing, then a rematch with the champion.

quests.title: The Washing of the Plaid
quests.summary: Hear the tale of the Corryvreckan and meet the Cailleach at the end of the pier.

steps.text: Ask the curator at the War and Peace Museum about the Corryvreckan.
Meet the Cailleach at the end of the North Pier and win her over.

quests.reward: The Cailleach joins you, plus a scrap of her plaid and two scallop suppers.
